description: Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter. It's also open source.
notes: Please manually disable Zed's auto-update feature in the settings to prevent the updater from installing the program in unintended locations.
Windows 11 first-level Open with Zed menu (current user; run in a normal, non-elevated terminal):
Remove the Windows 11 menu package and registry entry:
The menu uses current\appx and is not re-registered on each upgrade. If a future Zed release changes its extension package, run the install script again.
The paired install-win11-context.reg / uninstall-win11-context.reg control the menu title/visibility only; use the scripts for Appx registration/removal.
If the menu is cached, restart Windows Explorer. Do not register a menu from another Zed installation alongside this integration.
post_install: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $scriptdir)) { throw 'Install zed from this bucket by name so its companion scripts can be located.' }
# Windows 11 integration is per-user, including for global Scoop installations.

script: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Windows 11 menu cleanup failed. Run uninstall-win11-menu.ps1 before uninstalling.' }
